name: beta-Ga2O3, 273 K diffraction
citation: J. Åhman, G. Svensson and J. Albertsson. A Reinvestigation of β-Gallium Oxide. Acta Crystallographica Section C 52 (1996), 1336–1338.
recommendation: experimental source candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Experimental single-crystal X-ray structure refinement; CIF records Mo K-alpha radiation, R1=0.022, weighted R=0.032 and refined atomic coordinates/displacements.
notes: Both independent Ga sites must be retained: tetrahedral Ga (CN4) and octahedral Ga (CN6), each crystallographic multiplicity4 and weight1/2.
Do not represent beta-Ga2O3 by only one Ga site or multiply native path degeneracy by the crystallographic site multiplicity.
Occupancy is absent from the raw CIF loop; the ordered full-occupancy model is implicit rather than a measured occupation refinement.
Source bytes are the current COD distribution with original IUCr attribution notice, not a claim of identity with the original publisher supplement.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Original CIF: _diffrn_ambient_temperature 273 K, _cell_measurement_temperature 273.2 K; pressure unspecified. Cell and diffraction temperatures are retained as distinct reported values.

occupancy.interpretation: Occupancy column absent; unit occupancy is parser interpretation, not an explicit refined occupancy.
